mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / Iris Plus or later (Metal capable)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 / M2, or AMD Radeon Pro 560 / Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD (2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10 (shader model 4.0) compatible GPU Intel HD 4000+
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
